label: Bible Study
prompt: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and _____ shall be increased.
verse: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
note: Seal the book until the end — when many will run to and fro and knowledge will grow.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For mine _____ have seen thy salvation,
verse: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
note: Old Simeon held the baby Jesus in the temple and knew he'd seen enough: mine eyes have seen thy salvation.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the _____:
verse: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
note: The foolish builder heard the very same sermon; his only mistake was not doing it — and great was the fall.

label: Deep Water
prompt: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in _____ remember mercy.
verse: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
note: Habakkuk had heard the coming judgment; his prayer is that God would remember mercy in it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not _____ come out of your mouth: for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.
verse: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.
note: Hannah's song warns the proud: let not 'arrogancy' come out of your mouth — the KJV's longer cousin of arrogance.
